name: everything-software
description: Tapez un prompt, obtenez une mini-app web générée en temps réel (micro-services + moteur IA).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n storage,validator,mcp,ai,agents,voice,gateway,front -c blue,magenta,red,green,gray,white,yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w services/storage" "npm run dev -w services/validator" "npm run dev -w services/mcp-hub" "npm run dev -w services/ai-engine" "npm run dev:app-agents -w services/ai-engine" "npm run dev -w services/voice-gateway" "npm run dev -w services/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n storage,validator,mcp,ai,agents,voice,gateway,front "npm start -w services/storage" "npm start -w services/validator" "npm start -w services/mcp-hub" "npm start -w services/ai-engine" "npm run start:app-agents -w services/ai-engine" "npm start -w services/voice-gateway" "npm start -w services/api-gateway" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm test -w services/ai-engine && npm test -w services/validator && npm test -w @es/app-mcp && npm test -w @es/voice-gateway && npm test -w @es/mcp-hub && npm test -w @es/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @es/runtime && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start:services: concurrently -k -n storage,validator,mcp,ai,agents,voice,gateway "npm start -w services/storage" "npm start -w services/validator" "npm start -w services/mcp-hub" "npm start -w services/ai-engine" "npm run start:app-agents -w services/ai-engine" "npm start -w services/voice-gateway" "npm start -w services/api-gateway"
